team_injuries.name: Jalen Williams
team_injuries.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

opp_injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
opp_injuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

opp_injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
opp_injuries.note: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

opp_injuries.name: Bradley Beal
opp_injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

opp_injuries.name: Jordan Miller
opp_injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
